svg.title: The pause, cut and cut_form keys each CLI command leaves in the gate file
svg.desc: Three commands write the gate file router-gate.json. A plain pause sets paused true and reason, and withdraws any cut and cut_form left by an earlier pause. A pause with the cut flag sets paused, reason, cut true and cut_form (close by default, or error). Resume sets paused false and clears reason, cut and cut_form together, after which the router admits the requests the pause held in arrival order. Every write replaces the file by writing a scratch file and renaming it over the gate, so a router polling mid-write never reads a partial document.
svg.text: The pause, cut and cut_form keys each write leaves behind
all three write the same file, router-gate.json, which the running router polls once a second
a re-pause never inherits a cut it did not just ask for
cut the relays already in flight
cut_form defaults to close; an unknown value is refused by click
clear the pause and admit what it held
reason, cut and cut_form cleared together
the held and retried requests are admitted in arrival order
every write is atomic: a scratch file is written, then renamed over the gate, so a poll never reads a partial document
